title: Recall consumer conforms to chief E2 §3 (canonical): decision != SELLABLE -> no-scale + pull-error -> FAIL; supersedes the M6-OD-017 decision-exclusion; enforcement migration renumbered 0014 -> 0017
decision: M6 accepts chief E2_BLOCK_REASON_V1 §1/§3 as the canonical cross-module rule (it wins over the ops-core doc §4 'do not read decision' where they conflict). The M6-OD-017 'never read decision / block_reasons' clause is WITHDRAWN as a module-level narrowing of a chief-issued rule (flagged by the chief auditor 2026-09-16, B3). M6 conforms in slice M6.2U: (a) a recall/availability response whose decision is NOT observed as SELLABLE (NOT_SELLABLE, or an unknown / missing decision) makes the Scale-Gate Risk row FAIL -- a SELLABILITY no-scale signal that is DISTINCT from the recall-boolean derivation, so ops-core §4 'do not derive the recall booleans from decision' still holds while E2 §1/§3 'M6 does not scale when NOT_SELLABLE' is now honored; (b) a pull error / timeout / 429 / incomplete read makes the Risk row FAIL (not HOLD) and raises a 'khong xac minh duoc' signal for a running campaign (E2 §1 + ops-core gói chốt §6.3). SEPARATELY: the enforcement migration is renumbered 0014 -> 0017 (0014-0016 were taken by M6.2Q ads_spend); the OD-011 '0014_enforcement' is corrected in the registry and migrations/README.
